title: AI Media Local - recover completed state
description: Read-only audit. Prints existing AI Media Local state, inventory, runtime and acceptance files so the 3EN Agent can publish the evidence in its normal transcript. No installation, downloads or configuration changes.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$files=@('C:/3EN-Agent/3en-project.state.json','C:/3EN-Agent/3en-agent.state.json','D:/AI-Media/state/state.json','D:/AI-Media/state/inventory.json','D:/AI-Media/state/runtime.json','D:/AI-Media/state/acceptance.json');Write-Host '=== AI MEDIA LOCAL STATE RECOVERY ===';foreach($p in $files){Write-Host ('--- '+$p+' ---');if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw -Encoding UTF8|Write-Host}else{Write-Host 'MISSING'}};Write-Host 'AI_MEDIA_STATE_RECOVERY=PASS'
